question.problem: Calculate the height $h$ of a cylinder given that its volume is $72\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{3}$ and the ratio of its radius to its height is $3.$
question.worked_solution:
Using the fact that  the ratio of the radius of the base $r$ to the height $h$ is $3,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{r}{h} & =3 \\ r & =3h\end{aligned}
$$

The volume of a cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is given by

$$
V=\pi {r}^{2}h.
$$

Substituting $V=72\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{3}$ and $r=3h$ into the formula, we find the value of $h:$

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =\pi {r}^{2}h \\ 72\pi  & =\pi {(3h)}^{2}\cdot h \\ 72 & =9{h}^{3} \\ {h}^{3} & =8 \\ h & =2\,\text{mm}.\end{aligned}
$$
